notes: Federated-equivalence gate before privacy noise. Clients retain trajectories and transmit one loss plus three gradient entries per optimizer evaluation. Oracle-family and global groups are tested. Secure aggregation is a deterministic pairwise-mask floating-point emulator, not production cryptography and not dropout tolerant. The secure/plain absolute parameter tolerance is 1e-6 because floating-point mask cancellation can perturb the optimizer path; cryptographic fixed-point equivalence is not claimed. Gate: federated and secure estimates reproduce centralized fits within parameter and tracking tolerances; secure and plain federated estimates agree within secure_sum_tolerance; all fits converge; all controllers are feasible with frozen rho below one.
